# telnyx_email_domains (Data Source)

Lists email domains, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_domain`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_domain` (String)
- `filter_profile_id` (String)
- `filter_status` (String) One of `degraded`, `failed`, `pending`, `suspended`, `verified`, `verifying`.
- `filter_type` (String) One of `custom`, `shared`, `shared_inbound`.
- `filter_usable_for_inbound` (Boolean)
- `filter_usable_for_sending` (Boolean)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-domain`, `-updated_at`, `created_at`, `domain`, `updated_at`.

### Read-Only

- `email_domains` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains))

<a id="nestedatt--email_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_domains`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `dkim` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--dkim))
- `dmarc_policy` (Attributes) Customer DMARC policy. null means use the advisory default (v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@telnyx.com). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--dmarc_policy))
- `dns_records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--dns_records))
- `domain` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--inbound))
- `record_type` (String)
- `reputation` (Attributes) Sender reputation for this domain (present on all domain responses). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--reputation))
- `status` (String)
- `tracking` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--tracking))
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `usable_for_inbound` (Boolean)
- `usable_for_sending` (Boolean)
- `verification` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_domains--verification))
- `verified_at` (String)

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--email_domains--dmarc_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_domains.dmarc_policy`

Read-Only:

- `p` (String) Policy applied to messages that fail alignment.
- `pct` (Number) Percentage of messages the policy applies to. Omitted from the record when 100.
- `rua` (String) URI for aggregate reports. Defaults to the Telnyx address when absent; null omits it.
- `sp` (String) Policy for subdomains. Omitted from the record when null.

<a id="nestedatt--email_domains--reputation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_domains.reputation`

Read-Only:

- `band` (String) Reputation band, e.g. good/warn/poor.

<a id="nestedatt--email_domains--tracking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_domains.tracking`

Read-Only:

- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Rewrite HTML links through a tracking redirect to record click events.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Inject a tracking pixel into HTML messages to record open events.
- `unsubscribe_tracking` (Boolean) Add RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers with a signed one-click unsubscribe URL. Enabled by default; Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender rules require one-click unsubscribe support.
